name: finai
description: Markets dashboard with an AI financial analyst (Claude API or a local Llama model)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
